Bangumi requires each app to register separately; there is no shared default key. Sign in to your bgm.tv account and follow 开发者平台 → 我的应用 → 创建应用. Leave the "回调地址" (Redirect URI) field blank or enter exactly %1$s. Enter the generated App ID and App Secret under "Custom API Keys" below.
Step 2: Authorize with your Bangumi Account
When you tap the "允许" (Allow) button while signed in to Bangumi in your browser, the app connects automatically. The authorization code is valid for 60 seconds and can only be used once.
If your browser says "page can\'t be opened," do not worry: copy the full URL containing kitsugi://bangumi-auth?code=... from the address bar and paste it into step 3.
If the deep link did not work, paste the code (or the full address) shown on screen or in the address bar after authorizing:
Custom API Keys (App ID / App Secret)

The keys are stored only on this device and shared directly with bgm.tv; they are not sent to Kitsugi servers. If you distribute an APK, it is safer to ask users for their keys than to embed them in the build through local.properties (an embedded secret can be extracted because Bangumi does not support PKCE).

With the Kitsu Edge API, your anime and manga library, detailed filtering, seasonal discovery, favorites, and watch-time statistics stay seamlessly in sync.
The Shikimori v2 / v1 REST API supports anime and manga user lists, 1–10 rating distribution, activity history, and comprehensive search filters.

The Bangumi (bgm.tv) v0 API supports subject search (条目), seasonal and season-order discovery, episode lists, collection states (想看/在看/看过/搁置/抛弃), 0–10 ratings, and episode-by-episode progress (打格子). To sign in, register your own app at bgm.tv/dev/app.

This diagnostic tests the plugin search → detail → stream flow using the app’s existing network and WebView/cookie handling. That layer may process some challenge pages, but diagnostics do not force-disable per-host cooldowns. CF/WAF is counted only when an explicit protection signature is detected; providers may still deny access. Diagnostics never automatically disable plugins.
• Only installed/active plugins are tested locally (fast) • Search → Load → Stream pipeline (download is skipped) • Result: .md report + in-app view
• All plugins are tested in parallel (MAX=%1$d repositories) • Download → Search → Load → Stream pipeline • Result: .md report + in-app view

Could not establish a network connection
The device is offline, or the route to the target server (ISP, VPN, firewall) is closed. The request never reached the server.
Check your internet connection, turn off VPN/proxy and try again.
Domain name could not be resolved (DNS)
(unknownhost) The DNS server could not translate the domain into an IP address. Your ISP may be blocking it, the domain may have moved, or the platform changed its address.
Change the DNS-over-HTTPS provider under Settings > System, or try again over a VPN.
The server did not respond within the configured window. The server may be overloaded, the connection very slow, or the request was suspended in the background.
Try again in a few minutes; use a Wi-Fi connection where possible.
The certificate could not be verified. An intercepting VPN/proxy, a wrong device clock or an expired server certificate causes this.
Disable any VPN/proxy, check your device date and time, then retry.
The connection dropped before the transfer finished. This usually comes from an unstable mobile network or a brief server-side interruption.
Retry; if it persists, switch networks.
The platform reported that you exceeded the number of requests allowed within its time window. It appears when many requests are sent back to back during a sync.
Wait a few minutes; the app honours the Retry-After delay automatically.
The remote server could not process the request. This is almost always a temporary outage on their side, not an app problem.
Try again in a few minutes.
The server blocked the request. WAF/bot protection, a regional restriction, or a missing/spoofed header (User-Agent, Referer) triggers this.
Run the proxy or WebView verification; if needed, retry through a VPN.
The requested endpoint or record no longer exists. The id may be invalid, or the API version changed.
Search and re-match the entry, or refresh the record.
The access token is invalid and the automatic refresh failed. The token expired or was revoked on the platform side.
Sign in to the account again from Settings > Platforms.
The refresh token was revoked. A password change, a removed app authorisation or a very long idle period triggers this.
The session is valid, but the granted scopes are not enough to read or write the requested data.
Sign in again; if you use your own client credentials, add the required scopes.
The client id / API key is wrong, expired, or not authorised for this app.
Enter the correct key under Settings > Platforms.
There is no stored session for this platform, so the request was sent anonymously or skipped.
Sign in from Settings > Platforms to include it in sync.
The Redirect URI registered on the platform is not an exact match for the one sent by the app, so the authorisation code is rejected.
Register the redirect URI in the platform app settings, or use the manual code flow.
The platform does not recognise a field or query that was sent. The provider may have renamed fields or changed its contract.
Update the app; if it persists, share the report so it can be fixed.
The payload is not the expected JSON. The server may have returned an HTML error page, the body may be truncated, or the schema changed.
Retry; if it keeps happening, share the report.
The server returned a success code with an empty body. That means a temporary outage, a silent block, or a drained endpoint.
The sync was stopped by the user, the app went to the background, or the scope was cancelled.
The error signature did not match any known pattern, so the cause could not be determined automatically.
Copy the details and send them to the developer; a new code may be needed.
The local entry could not be matched to a record on the platform. A title/year difference, a missing alternative title, or a record that does not exist yet causes this.
Match the entry manually or correct the title.
The identity guard blocked writing an id that may belong to a different title.
Verify the entry match and try again.
The request needs to go through the proxy, but no key is configured, so it fails.
Enter the proxy key in Settings.
After repeated failures the platform was paused for a while; requests are deliberately not sent during that window.
It will be retried automatically once the cooldown ends.
The server returned a body larger than the read limit; the data was truncated for safety and parsing could not finish.
Narrow the filters or repeat the operation in smaller chunks.
AniList is in degraded mode (30 req/min)
AniList has temporarily lowered its documented 90 req/min limit to 30 req/min. Heavy syncing therefore returns 429.
The app paces requests automatically; avoid restarting the sync repeatedly.
The GraphQL response returned \"Too Many Requests\". Besides the per-minute limit, AniList runs a separate burst limiter against short request spikes.
Wait a minute; the Retry-After delay is applied automatically.
The AniList GraphQL layer could not process the request, which happens during brief service-side degradation.
Try again in a few minutes.
The access token expired and the refresh was rejected, leaving requests unauthorised.
Sign in again via Settings > Platforms > AniList.
The account list is set to private, so the API returns empty data and the sync finishes with 0 records.
Make the list visible in your AniList profile settings.
The account\'s scoring format (100 / 10 decimal / 10 / 5 stars / 3-point smiley) does not match the value being sent, so scores are rejected.
Align the score format with your account in Settings.
The matched AniList media id may have been deleted or merged into another entry.
Jikan (the community API serving MAL data) is limited to 3 requests/second and 60 requests/minute. It returns 429 when the quota is used up.
Wait; the app applies the quota cooldown automatically.
MAL API v2 returned 429 because too many requests were sent in a short window.
Wait a few minutes and retry.
MAL API v2 does not expose personal notifications; Kitsugi reads them through the signed-in MAL website. OAuth API authorization does not share the website session cookie.
Open Notifications and choose “Connect MAL web session” to sign in to your MAL account.
List visibility is disabled on the profile, so the API returns an empty list.
Make the list public in your MAL profile settings.
The id belongs to the wrong type (anime/manga mix-up) or the record was merged into another id.
Jikan is down or in maintenance
Jikan is temporarily offline (503) or overloaded; the app falls back to the official MAL API.
The access token expired and the PKCE refresh flow failed.
Sign in again with your MAL account.
Kitsu has moved its domain between kitsu.io and kitsu.app; the old host can enter a redirect loop or return empty responses.
The app retries on the current host automatically; report it if it persists.
Kitsu allows 60 requests/minute and an additional burst limit for short spikes; exceeding it returns 429.
No library entry was found for this title on Kitsu; the lookup that runs before a write returned nothing.
Create the entry on Kitsu, or add it again from the app.
The JSON:API relationship payload was not in the expected shape; the anime/manga link came back missing or malformed.
Shikimori allows 5 requests per second; exceeding it returns 429.
The token is valid, but the app was not granted the unread message/notification scope, so counts cannot be read.
Create your own Shikimori app with \'user_rates messages\' scopes and sign in again with those credentials.
The browser shows \"The requested redirect uri is malformed or doesn\'t match client redirect URI\" because the registered address is not an exact match.
Add the app\'s exact redirect URI to your Shikimori application, or use the manual code flow.
The status, score or episode value sent does not satisfy Shikimori\'s rules, so the record was rejected.
Check the score format and status value.
The request was caught by WAF/bot protection, usually because of a missing or suspicious User-Agent or rapid repeated calls.
Run the proxy or WebView verification.
The access token expired and the refresh attempt was rejected as well.
Sign in again with your Shikimori account.
The Bangumi API rejects the `nsfw` filter sent as a string (\"include\") and expects JSON `null`/`true`. Sending text makes the search return HTTP 400 and an empty result.
The app uses the correct JSON form; share the report if the error persists.
The access token expired, so the collection fetch stayed unauthorised.
Sign in again with your Bangumi account (a refresh is attempted automatically).
The subject id is invalid, deleted, or redirected to another record.
Bangumi caps deep pagination via offset; very large collections get cut off past a certain point.
Sync in filtered or smaller batches.
The `subject type` value does not match the expected kind (1 book, 2 anime, 3 music, 4 game, 6 real). The wrong type yields empty results.
Bangumi requires an identifying User-Agent header on every request; a missing or generic one is rejected.
The app sends its default header; do not override it with a custom one.
The API key is missing, wrong, or the v3/v4 formats are mixed up. TMDB v3 expects an \"api_key\" query parameter, v4 expects a Bearer token.
Enter the correct TMDB key type in Settings.
No TMDB data in the selected language
TMDB falls back to the original language when no translation exists in the chosen language, so titles may arrive in English or Japanese.
This is expected; you can change the language preference in Settings.
The id was deleted or the title is not in TMDB at all; since TMDB grows through community contributions, very new titles appear late.
Search with a different title or retry later.
The per-second request limit was exceeded, which happens when the explore screen fires many requests in a row.
The PIN verification code passed its validity window (about 5 minutes) and is no longer accepted.
Generate a new PIN and approve it at simkl.com/pin.
Simkl PIN could not be verified (401)
The PIN was not approved, or the session dropped during polling, so the server answers unauthorised.
Approve the PIN on the Simkl page and reconnect the account.
The client_id is missing or not approved for your Simkl application, so the authorisation request was rejected.
Check the client_id in your Simkl application settings.
Simkl accepts one request per second; faster bursts return 429.
Wait — requests are automatically paced to 1 second apart.
The data.simkl.in calendar file returned an empty body, so airing matches could not be computed.
The error signature did not match any known pattern; raw details are listed below.
Copy the details and send them to the developer.
